subject.title: Feature: --agent flag for TUI to select which agent handles the session

question: Should `openclaw tui` add a permanent `--agent <id>` startup selector when agent-scoped `--session` values and workspace inference already select the target agent?
rationale: This is a new public CLI surface rather than a missing routing capability, and the required precedence contract is a product and compatibility choice.

options.title: Retain current selectors
options.body: Document the canonical `--session agent:<id>:<session>` and workspace-based startup paths rather than add a parallel flag.

options.title: Add a supported alias
options.body: Add `--agent` with validation and explicit precedence over or under agent-scoped sessions and workspace inference, plus focused CLI and TUI coverage.

recommendation.title: Retain current selectors
recommendation.body: Document the canonical `--session agent:<id>:<session>` and workspace-based startup paths rather than add a parallel flag.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent review and current-main TUI history connect this person most directly to the CLI and resolver contract.
